entries.msgstr: The Resistor shoves raw plasma into every single shell. With a gun like this, von Krieger's latest monstrosity won't last the afternoon. It's overdriven and vicious; all I need. And as for his Blitzträger? Bigger isn't better. Every shot we land is a small argument against everything he's ever bolted together. Although, between us, I'm not sure the man driving it is still the man. The way he talks lately, something else might be picking his words. Doesn't matter. Whoever's at the controls is going to catch the same plasma.
Major modernization of the main battle tank
Each overloaded Generator will charge Silver Bullet with Plasma. The more Charges, the more damage Plasma causes. Shoot when the Blitzträger's shield is down for maximum damage.
